research_notes: SOURCE ACCESS: www.btn.co.id sits behind Imperva/Incapsula; curl from this server gets a 302 cookie-challenge loop (not bypassed). INTERIM: 9M2026 is not published yet. BTN told OJK/IDX that its 30 Sep 2026 interim FS will be limited-reviewed by a public accountant because of a corporate action planned before end-2026 (Kontan 1 Oct 2026: capital strengthening options incl. a remaining Rp3tn subordinated-bond ceiling, and Rp300-400bn of securitisation); limited-reviewed interim statements are normally due within two months of the period end (i.e. by end-Nov 2026). The interim block is H1 2026.

GROUP SCOPE / SHARIA SPIN-OFF: until 5 Jun 2025 BTN had no subsidiaries (AR2024 PDF p. 193 (printed p. 191): no subsidiaries, associates, JV or SPV); its sharia business was an internal Sharia Business Unit (UUS, 'BTN Syariah') included in every BTN statement. On 5 Jun 2025 BTN acquired 99.9984% of PT Bank Victoria Syariah (goodwill Rp527,705 juta), renamed it PT Bank Syariah Nasional (BSN; deed 27 Aug 2025, OJK approval of the new name 24 Sep 2025), and spun the UUS off into BSN effective 22 Dec 2025 (FS2025 Note 1i, PDF pp. 44-47). So FY2025 and the H1 2026 interim are consolidated (BTN + BSN) and still include all sharia assets/deposits; growth 2024->2025 is NOT distorted by the spin-off at the consolidated level (it adds the small ex-BVIS book). But OJK INDIVIDUAL (bank-only) ratios from 31 Dec 2025 exclude the sharia balance sheet, so FY2025 and interim ratios are not like-for-like with FY2020-FY2024 (which covered the whole entity incl. UUS). FY2025 consolidated CAR 20.92% and 1H2026 consolidated CAR 20.05% are given in notes.

BASIS: fy.2019-2024 money figures come from BTN's single-entity audited financial statements (no subsidiaries) and are stored as basis 'consolidated' because they are the whole group; fy.2025 and interim are true consolidated figures. Ratios are OJK bank ratios ('bank_only'), which for 2020-2024 equal the whole entity.

DEPOSITS DEFINITION: fy.*.deposits = balance-sheet 'Total simpanan dari nasabah' (conventional + wadiah deposits from customers). It EXCLUDES temporary syirkah (mudharabah) customer deposits (2024: 29,216.772; 2025: 31,856.042 IDR bn), which BTN counts in its own 'Dana Pihak Ketiga' (DPK, 2024: 381,667.001 per AR2024 PDF p. 341) and in its reported LDR/CASA. Loans_gross INCLUDES sharia financing (Note 11 total), matching BTN's 'Total Loan & Financing'. This follows the BBNI precedent; a computed loans/deposits ratio will be higher than the reported LDR.

RATIO SOURCES: FY2020-FY2024 OJK ratios (ROE, ROA, NIM, NPL, LDR, KPMM, BOPO, CASA, CIR) from AR2024's five-year table, cross-checked against AR2020-AR2023: identical except FY2023 KPMM (AR2023: 20.16; AR2024: 20.07, stored). LAR, NPL coverage and CoC for 2020-2024 from the FY2024 analyst deck (same values in the FY2023 deck for 2020-2023) EXCEPT LAR 2021: the FY2024 deck prints 24.2% but the FY2021 deck (26.75%) and FY2023 deck (26.8%) agree, so 26.75% is stored. ROE is the OJK Tier-1-based ROE (the deck labels it 'ROE (Tier-1)'). FY2025 and H1 2026 ratios are from the OJK published reports (individual).

NIM JUMP: FY2025 individual NIM 4.20% vs 2.86% in 2024 is real per the OJK published report; consolidated net interest and profit-sharing income rose from 11,492.652 to 18,218.549 IDR bn (FS2025 PDF p. 20) while interest expense was flat.

SHARES / RIGHTS ISSUE: the only share-count change since 2019 is the PMHMETD II rights issue (ex-right 23 Dec 2022; 10.59bn -> 14,034,444,413 shares, completed Jan 2023). No splits, reverse splits or bonus issues since listing (AR2024 share-listing chronology PDF pp. 194-196); no share buybacks/treasury shares 2020-2025. FY2022: the audited balance sheet still shows 10,590,000,000 issued shares plus a Rp2,756,575 juta capital deposit inside equity, while the AR share table prints 12.87bn shares outstanding for Q4 2022 (rights exercised before year-end); the audited count is stored. A BVPS computed for FY2022 from these levels therefore uses 10.59bn shares against equity that already includes most of the rights money (overstated); AR2022 itself prints BVPS Rp2,131.

EPS: as printed, never restated. FY2022 EPS 288 (10.59bn shares) was not restated for the bonus element of the rights issue in later reports. eps x shares_out vs net_profit_attr: 2020 -0.2%, 2021 -0.2%, 2022 +0.2%, 2023 -0.2%, 2024 -0.1%, 2025 -0.2%.

DIVIDENDS: one final cash dividend per year, no interim or special dividends (statements of changes in equity show a single payment per year: 2022 237.624, 2023 609.015, 2024 700.198, 2025 751.833; none in 2021 and none in H1 2026). No dividend for FY2020 (AGMS 10 Mar 2021: all profit to reserves) or FY2025 (AGMS 23 Apr 2026: 0% payout, all to retained earnings to fund loan growth) - both stored as payout_ratio 0 with the AGMS source, and there are no dividend records for those years. Payout x profit vs stated totals: within 0.01% for FY2021-FY2024. DPS x FY-end shares: FY2022 off by 24.5% because the dividend was paid on the post-rights share count (explained in validation_ack).

RESTATEMENTS: none found. Each year's figures are as originally reported in that year's audited FS; the later comparatives (AR2021-AR2024, FS2025) show identical totals. FY2020 equity is lower than FY2019 mainly because of the PSAK 71/73 transition adjustment (-Rp6,180,134 juta to retained earnings on 1 Jan 2020, AR2020 PDF p. 698).
